Customer requirements should be put at the forefront to deliver the best product at the lowest possible price. Therefore, the main objective of the feasibility study object of this SoW is the demonstration of theeconomic viability w/o public funding of a proposed launch service making use of a micro-launcher responding to customers' requirements, in relation with technical concept tradeoff and analysis.
